purpose: Packages under pkg/ that still carry unfinished Packaged Service Structure migration intent. This is the single consolidated ledger for open moves; it replaces the per-package rows that ownership-inventory.json and package-target-manifest.json used to each carry separately.
endState: This ledger only shrinks. Landing a move deletes its row; it is never a place to register a package that already lives where it belongs. When moves is empty, delete this file together with its loaders and checks.

fieldNotes.destination: Committed destination bucket, owner-relative: either <owner> or <owner>/internal or <owner>/internal/services/<subservice>. Validated against the closed destination vocabulary.
fieldNotes.successor: Repository-relative package path that replaces this package once the move lands. Always sits under pkg/services/<owner> for the destination owner.
fieldNotes.deletionCondition: The named cutover proof that closes this row, when the migration packet named one. Optional: three factory_sessions runtimeopening rows were only ever tracked by package-target-manifest.json, which recorded no condition for them.
